name: solve-lite
description: Local-first bounded decision routing, calibrated percentages, token truth, and auditable rewards for ordinary Codex Desktop sessions. Fresh installs run on the bundled LITE runtime with no asset root; specialist capabilities install as optional DLC components.

interface.longDescription: Routes ordinary Codex Desktop prompts through the local Solve Lite parent router and exposes evidence-backed percentages, token status, and reward settlement. A plain clone is complete: the LITE runtime is bundled, no asset root is configured, and specialist capabilities install as optional DLC components from the release.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Solve Lite automatically for this ordinary Codex session.
